item.title: Events being planned at Ireland West Airport to celebrate 40th anniversary
item.description: A number of big events are being planned to mark Knock Airport's 40th anniversary this year. The popular local airport opened in 1986 thanks to the work by the likes Monsignor James Horan. It now has over 20 destinations to fly to and welcomed over 900,000 passengers last year. Head of Marketing at Ireland West Airport, Donal Healy, says it will be a year of celebration in 2026: Advertisement

item.title: Over 44,000 cars failed NCT in Shannonside Northern Sound region last year
item.description: Over 44,000 cars failed the NCT in the Shannonside Northern Sound region across 2025. The statistics were made available on the official NCT website. Just over 79,000 tests were carried out in Carrick-on-Shannon, Castlerea, Cavan, Longford and Monaghan between January and December. Castlerea had the highest pass rate in the region at 45.64%. That was followed by Carrick-on-Shannon at 44.72% and Monaghan at 42.16%. Across all three centres there were over 7,146 dangerous failures. Advertisement

item.title: Local hospital third busiest in the country today
item.description: A local hospital is continuing to deal with overcrowding. The latest INMO figures show that Sligo University Hospital was the third most overcrowded this morning. There were 26 waiting for a bed, with 17 in the emergency department and 9 in wards elsewhere. Letterkenny University Hospital is the country's most overcrowded hospital with 43 recorded there. item.title: Man in a critical condition following serious assault in Ballaghaderreen
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for witnesses following a serious assault in Ballaghadereen. The incident occurred at around 1am yesterday morning on Barrack Street. Gardaí say a man in his 30s was brought to Beaumont Hospital, Dublin, where he remains in a critical condition. A Senior Investigating Officer has been appointed and an incident room has been established in Castlerea Garda Station. Gardaí are appealing to anyone who may have witnessed this incident to contact them. Advertisement

item.title: Man arrested in connection with serious assault in Ballaghaderreen
item.description: A man has been arrested in connection with a serious assault in Roscommon which left another man in a critical condition. The injured man in his 30s is being treated in Beaumont Hospital in Dublin following the incident on Barrack Street in Ballaghdereen in the early hours of yesterday morning. This afternoon, Gardaí arrested a man in his 40s in connection with the incident. He's being questioned at a Garda station in the north-west, where he can be held for up to 24 hours. Advertisement
